Separate outDir per suite — see tests/tsconfig.registry.json for why. `lib/client-claim-corroboration.ts` is pure: no I/O, no Supabase, no next/*, and its day arithmetic is over an epoch instant and a fixed offset, so it returns the same answer whatever timezone the machine running the suite is in. That is what lets the IST/UTC boundary be ASSERTED at the exact instant that used to fail, rather than described in a comment. `lib/active-close.ts` is compiled with it because it is the pattern's first caller and the file the bug lived in; its browser half is never called here.
